name: Ant Foraging
description: A model of ants foraging for food. This is a classic agent-based modeling example that shows intelligent system behavior emerging from simple individual behavior.

name: Boids 3D
description: Demonstrates the "Boids" flocking algorithm in both 2D and 3D space.

name: City Infection Model
description: This model simulates how a virus spreads through a human population.

name: Connection Example
description: The simulation demonstrates how you might handle agents linking, or connecting, while avoiding any race conditions.

name: Empty Project
description: This is a new simulation — an empty scaffold to build from.

name: Empty Template Project
description: This starter template shows how to use basic features of HASH.

name: Model Market
description: This model contains two types of agents: shops and buyers.

name: Published Display Behaviors
description: Separate all display elements from agents with published composable behaviors.

name: Rainfall
description: Demonstrates the use of library behaviors to simulate rainfall and pooling behavior.

name: Rumor Mill: Public Health Practices
description: This simulation models the spread of hygiene practices in a community, and their trust in a federal authority.

name: Sugarscape
description: This simulation implements Epstein and Axtell's Sugarscape model.

name: Virus Mutation and Drug Resistance
description: This model simulates mutation in viruses and bacteria, with vaccine introduction at a specific timestep.

name: Warehouse Logistics
description: A basic warehouse model with shelf agents and worker agents handling item storage and retrieval.

name: Wildfires - Regrowth
description: This model simulates the spread of wildfires in a regrowing forest. Trees grow over time and have a small chance of being struck by lightning.
